def get_shape(val: Any) -> Optional[List[int]]:
    return val.type().sizes()

def bmm_flop_jit(inputs: List[Any], outputs: List[Any]) -> Number:
    input_shapes = [get_shape(v) for v in inputs]
    assert len(input_shapes) == 2, input_shapes
    assert len(input_shapes[0]) == 3, input_shapes[0]
    assert len(input_shapes[1]) == 3, input_shapes[1]
    assert input_shapes[0][0] == input_shapes[1][0], input_shapes
    assert input_shapes[0][2] == input_shapes[1][1], input_shapes
    n, c, t = input_shapes[0]
    p = input_shapes[1][2]
    flop = n * c * t * p
    return flop
